title: The Deepest Hall
journal: The Eye of Argonia is the old priest-kings' jewel. It sits at the Root, under the sea below Teku-Sul Spire, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there, it can heal every sick tree. The last king shut it behind the Kings' Gate, which opens only with three seal-stones. The third seal-stone lies in the vault of Vorannuhl's deep halls, behind a door of bronze. Sarpa raiders shelter in the outer yard, and one of them, Hesh-Var, carries the bronze key. I'm to get the key: lift it from him unseen, or kill him and take it.
objectives: Get the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl from Hesh-Var in the outer yard. (marker: Hesh-Var, Vorannuhl)

plan.going: The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits at the Root under Teku-Sul, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there it heals every sick tree. The Kings' Gate shuts it in and opens only with three seal-stones. I am hunting the third seal-stone, in Vorannuhl's deep vault, the hardest place of the hunt
plan.next: get the bronze key from Hesh-Var at the yard's fire
plan.ways: pickpocket it from him unseen (Sneak and Pickpocket), or fight the raiders and take it from his body (any fighting skill); the raiders shoot strangers

answers: I seek the Eye of Argonia, which can heal every sick tree at the Root under Teku-Sul Spire. The Kings Gate needs three seal-stones. I hold two and the third is in the vault of Vorannuhl behind a bronze door.
Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard here at Vorannuhl.
Lift the key unseen (pickpocket) or kill him and take it. The game favours force.
I do not fully understand why the Unbound drain trees; I would find out by exploring and talking to people.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I have the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls, and their lord, a wraith, guards the vault. I'm to go down, open the vault with the key and take the stone. I can fight, slip past or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Open the Vault of the Household with the bronze key and take the seal-stone. (marker: Door to Vault of the Household, Household's Hoard)

plan.going: I hold the key; the stone is in the vault below
plan.next: go down, open the vault, take the stone
plan.ways: fight the plague-dead and the wraith-lord; sneak past them; turn them with Restoration

answers: I killed Hesh-Var and have the Bronze Key. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls and a wraith lord guards the vault with the third seal-stone.
Go to the Door to the Vault of the Household, open it with the key and take the seal-stone.
Fight the dead, slip past them, or turn them with Restoration.
I do not know what the wraith lord is exactly or what the Household Hoard holds besides the stone.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I took the third seal-stone from the vault of Vorannuhl. I now carry all three seal-stones. Never-Writes-Twice ordered all three brought to her before anyone goes near the gate. I'm to bring them to her in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.

plan.going: I hold all three seal-stones of the Kings' Gate
plan.next: bring them to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom, as her orders said, before going to the gate
plan.ways: none; the report is the step

answers: I now hold all three seal-stones. Never-Writes-Twice wants them brought to her before anyone goes to the Kings Gate. The Eye must not be lifted.
Bring the stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.
Go there as ordered, or go straight to the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire from Bell Station, though the journal says to bring them to her first.
Still unknown: why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound.
